lines: The smokescreen was still drifting through the airport, but there was no sign of the pair from before.
「Who on earth are those two? Doesn't seem like they're just a Hell Knight and a wind user......」
The subordinates who had been knocked out appeared to have woken up as well.
「Chase after them, of course. There's no doubt those two are connected to the terrible state of this place.」
「Each of you disperse and conduct a search. If you find them, notify me immediately.」
「We don't know anything about those two. It looks like they have no intention of harming us, but make sure to be very careful.」
After issuing quick instructions to her subordinates, Tomoe made her cheek twitch, and placed a hand on her sword.
She took a quick-draw stance, facing a place where nobody was.
「Even if you're hiding, I can tell. You're the one who interfered with those smoke bombs, aren't you? Come out. Otherwise―――」
Her bared sword shot out of its scabbard.
The slash that she had unleashed cut the smoke that was still wafting through the air right in half,
And sparks flew as it was deflected in a place where nothing was.
「My apologies. I didn't really mean to remain hidden.」
The one who appeared there, after he undid his optical camouflage, was a handsome man with glasses and a black suit.
If this were Asuka, she would have realized that he was the pickup artist who had mistaken her for Lena.
And, that his appearance was a little different from back then.
Both of the man's arms had hardened like metal, and sharp blades were extending from them.
He had deflected Tomoe's slash with those.
「Going by your appearance, a cyborg? Who are you? Are you a friend of the people who are lying over there? Or those two?」
「No, I am neither of those. That isn't to say I'm unconnected, though.」
「But, as it seems a number of misunderstandings have arisen, I should explain this to you.」
The slender man retracted the blades in both arms.
That seemed to mean that he had no intention of fighting.
「All right. I'll hear you out. I'm a Taimanin, Kuroda Tomoe. First give me your name.」
Having run away from Tomoe, Lena and Asuka were conversing in a part of the airport where they wouldn't be seen.
It seemed that the electrical system had been damaged by the earlier commotion, and the lights were out, so it was dark.
It was convenient for having a secret conversation.
「―――I see. So that's why you got mistaken for me.」
「It's because you were late for your meeting, you know? Thanks to that, I got attacked by those weird cyborgs, and even Taimanin appeared. I can't stand any more.」
「That information dealer's a poor excuse for a pro, too, for him to get his target wrong. He did help us before, though.」
「That smokescreen. He hid using optical camouflage and spoke to me. That was your trading partner, right? Who is he?」
「I don't really know either. Nothing but the fact that he's a cyborg information dealer.」
Lena said, with a concerned-looking face.
It looked like she wasn't lying. She didn't seem like the type who could do something like that.
「That aside, I'm truly sorry I did that to you. You're right. I apologize!」
That was surprising meekness for a demon.
Feeling let down somehow, without thinking, Asuka asked,
「You really are a Nomad Hell Knight, yeah?」
Lena puffed her chest out proudly.
「That's right! I'm a Hell Knight of Nomad!」
「They call me Lena the Storm Knight. Lately, I've taken a liking to the name, Sakura Storm Wardancer as well.」
「Well, I don't really care about your nicknames, though.」
Had she wanted Asuka to say that was cool or something? This was one weird demon.
「So, what kind of data is this?」
Asuka still hadn't handed over the memory card that she had mistakenly received.
Despite having properly apologized, Lena awkwardly hesitated to speak again.
「Hold right on. You dragged me into this situation......」
「I-I know that. I really feel bad about it!」
「But I need that thing. Please, give it to me.」
「I can't hand it over just because you say so. This could be some dangerous data.」
「It's...... Uuuh...... If you won't hand it over to me no matter what, then I have no choice.」
Not only would Lena not tell her properly, but she even went so far as to be about to lay her hand on her sword.
Understandably, even Asuka had gotten pissed off.
「Hey!! Is that okay for someone who makes any pretence of calling herself a knight?」
「To drag someone who has nothing to do with this into their problems, and use brute force on them without even explaining properly?! You don't deserve to be called a knight!」
Lena opened her eyes wide, and became dejected.
「Y-You're right...... Then I wouldn't be qualified to be a knight......」
It looked like she really didn't want to say what the contents were.
「Haah, what's on the disk aside, those cyborgs came to retrieve this, right? And then even a strange Taimanin showed up.」
「Skilled for sure, but she's awfully hardheaded. Or maybe I should say, she's not inclined to listen to people.」
「The Taimanin I know is a little more flexible, though.」
Asuka inadvertently mumbled, thinking of Fuuma, who had helped her a few times.
「You have a friend in the Taimanin?」
「Y-Yeah. Kinda. When you've got this kind of power, you make an acquaintance or two.」
「Uh, but I'm not a Gosha Taimanin.」
「I know. We both got attacked together, after all.」
「Totally treating us like the culprits behind wrecking the airport! Though I won't say we're entirely without responsibility...」
「No, those cyborgs were the ones who used those kind of weapons in a place like that. We just defended ourselves.」
「The Taimanin may be archenemies of Nomad, but as a Hell Knight, I don't want to be blamed for stuff I haven't even done!」
Lena said firmly, like she had forgotten that she had just been about to start a fight.
「Why don't you try getting in touch with your Taimanin friend?」
He wouldn't give Asuka a phone number, or even an email address, saying, “If I give you my contact info, there's no telling what kind of trouble will unfold.”
「That's what I think, but it seems like he sees it as an unsavoury relationship. Basically, he's an ingrate.」
She was getting worked up, grumbling about a guy who wasn't here, when
They jumped at almost the exact same time.
「Those Taimanin from before again? No, the aura is different.」
「Those cyborgs again, huh? There are more of them than before.」
「Okay, leave this one to me. It's my responsibility in the first place.」
Lena tried to let Asuka go on ahead without hesitation.
Her attitude in that area was certainly that of a knight.
「No point. Those guys are after me.」
「Besides, we can't fight in a place like this again. We'll get out of the building for now. A little bit of gunfire will be fine if we're on the runway.」
「Okay, got it. By the way, what's your name?」
Come to think of it, Asuka still hadn't given her name.
It was too much trouble to use a pseudonym, so she just offered her given name.
The impromptu partners rushed out of the building.
The takeoff and landing of aircraft had completely stopped, due to the uproar from the explosion and fire earlier.
「Fufu, this is ideal for a battle.」
If they were outdoors, it would be easy for Asuka to use her Wind Escape Arts, too.
「Cyborg scoundrels! I'll turn you to scrap with Sakura Blossom!」
Lena also readied her demonic sword.
A different wind from Asuka's was enveloping her body, making her chestnut locks flutter gently.
「Looks like you've resigned yourselves, eh, little girls?」
「We'll collect the goods from your dead bodies.」
What had appeared were, as before, cyborgs with briefcase cannons and shoulder machine guns, and
They had even brought Drone Dogs along.
Of course, they weren't half-junk, like the ones back in Tokyo Kingdom.
「Honestly, what are they thinking, even bringing out drones like those? Lena, I'll entrust you with the close-quarters combat!」
